title: Spotify launches audiobooks in India (Thu 12 Nov 2026). Audiobooks+ add-on: ₹199 a month for 15 hours of listening after a one-month free trial for new subscribers; billed on top of a Premium plan, and free-plan users can add it too; unused hours expire each billing month; one-off top-ups and single-title purchases available; time is counted at normal playback speed. Catalogue at launch: 3.5 lakh+ English titles and about 7,000 audiobooks in Hindi, Tamil, Bengali, Marathi, Telugu, Kannada and Malayalam (launch titles include Ponniyin Selvan, Godaan, Kabuliwala). Page Match: scan a printed book's ISBN barcode to resume the audio from the same page. India is part of Spotify's audiobook expansion from 22 to 180+ markets (announced 7 Oct 2026).
headline: Spotify Audiobooks+ in India: 15 Hours for ₹199 a Month
